steps.label: What it is
steps.why: The name records where the bone forms, not what it looks like, so the definition has to name the tendon.
common_mistakes: Calling it a bone of the skull or of the limb. A sesamoid bone lies inside a tendon.
Writing that it is a cartilage. It is a bone, formed by ossification.
steps.memory_tip: Sesamoid bones are tendon bones: the tendon itself turns to bone where it rubs over a joint.
steps.margin_note: One sentence. Say tendon, and say ossification.
lines: A sesamoid bone is a small bone that lies
It is formed by ossification of the tendon
where the tendon passes over a joint.

steps.label: Example
steps.why: The patella is the example every paper expects, and saying which tendon holds it shows the definition was understood.
common_mistakes: Giving no example. The patella carries the second mark.
steps.memory_tip: Patella is the knee cap, sitting in the tendon in front of the knee.
steps.margin_note: Name the patella. One extra line placing it is enough.
